propositions: All in-tree structured-mode consumers (library, CLI, MCP, plan-review, code-review, overlap, enrich, epic-bug-screen, evals, workflow) must route exclusively through the PydanticAIRunner facade to ensure single-sourced structured dispatch.

The one-operation bounded Pydantic Agent path replaces all bespoke output-retry loops and manual retry machinery; output repair occurs via in-Agent retries={"output":N}, not scheduler-based fresh-Agent reconstruction.

The structured_retry_limit parameter, when set to zero, must guarantee single-shot behavior (zero output-repair retries and zero request-limit addend) to preserve the batch-abstain fail-safe in overlap/judge and contracts modules.
A well-formed first structured response must trigger exactly one outer agent.run_sync invocation; a second run_sync is only sanctioned on bug-895c native-to-prompted downgrade; never a third.
